Comment.Language: For the Commemoration of Anba Abraam Bishop of Fayoum:

Text.Language: Wouniatk qen oumeym/i: peniwt e#y#u# n~dikeoc: abba Abraam pip~ickopoc pimenrit n~te P,#c#.
Blessed are you indeed, our father the righteous Saint, Abba Abraam the Bishop, the beloved of Christ.
طوباك بالحقيقة يا أبانا القديس البار انبا ابرآم الاسقف حبيب المسيح.
